description: RFC 8621 §5.8 says Email/parse SHOULD support the same properties as Email/get including header: dynamic properties. The handler silently ignores them today (filed as correctness bug JMAP-yqo.1). But the maintainer risk is: any contributor who adds header: support to Email/get will not notice it is missing from Email/parse, and users who request dynamic headers via Email/parse will get silent null values with no error. The surface is public API that users will immediately depend on.
title: header: properties not validated or processed in Email/parse — public API gap
